reviews.text: this has been an amazing experience my dog has learned a lot with our trainer leslie and we’ve learned a lot as well haha 😂

Leslie is amazing with Louis! She was his trainer and now walks him, so she knows him very well. She is caring, patient, and trustworthy. We feel very comfortable knowing Louis is in her hands. Highly recommend her!
Leslie is incredible with Louis! She was his trainer and now walks him, so she knows him very well. She is caring, patient, and responsible. It gives us great peace of mind knowing Louis is in her hands. We highly recommend her!

Our experience with Canine Counselors was excellent! Laura was the perfect choice. She is amazing, trustworthy,  caring, patient, knowledgeable, and extremely skilled at managing dog behavior.  She helped our boy tremendously, and we saw a big improvement in his behavior. Thank you, Laura, for helping our boy become the  well-behaved pup he is today!

If you're looking for a dog trainer who is kind, knowledgeable, and truly invested in your dog's success, I wholeheartedly recommend Laura. She is absolutely amazing! 🐶❤️
The training system is excellent; Mr. Andrés handles the techniques very well. Our puppy learned all the commands and obedience in just a few weeks.

Had a great experience with our trainer Andres, friendly and loving to my puppy, she learned several things like walking by my side, sitting, down, paw and other basic commands.knowledgeable and experienced trainer🐶🙏🏻
Leslie was an amazing trainer! She was very knowledgeable and  loving to Max . She gave us great advice on how to handle our dog Max. I highly recommend Leslie Jaramillo!❤️

Best dog training, so nice and reliable. They really work well with your dog, they would meet with you first in person to establish what you need and how much it will be and coordinate how long and how often the classes will be. They have great methods to training and are very patient and they would come to your home to teach so your dog is comfortable and so they can learn from their home environment. We had Leslie as our trainer and we couldn’t have asked for a better trainer, a very nice kind experienced trainer that works so well with dogs and she really showed us results with our dog. I would totally recommend these guys 100%.

We’ve had such a great experience with this dog training company, and especially with our trainer, Leslie! She has been incredibly patient, knowledgeable, and supportive throughout the entire process. She takes the time to explain everything clearly and makes sure we understand not only what to do, but why it works.
Mr. Andres trained my puppy. He learned a lot from him; he was very patient and knew how to teach him everything. Thank you so much, I'm very satisfied and grateful.

My family had a great learning experience with Kie. He was very professional and communicative during all sessions. The approach was comprehensive but tailored considering our needs. The biggest benefit we obtained was to better understand the needs of our dog, and develop confidence to practice within the program and address challenges. We appreciate the positive impact this brought to our home.

We recently completed our puppy Fuji’s training with Kie, and we couldn’t be happier with the experience. Fuji, our Shiba Inu, absolutely adores him and has always been excited to see him at every session, which says a lot.

Kie is an outstanding trainer who combines professionalism, confidence, and consistency. He taught Fuji all the essential commands using positive, structured training, while also showing us how to reinforce those behaviors in our daily routine so Fuji continues to learn and thrive long after the sessions ended.

Throughout the program, Kie was always punctual, responsive, and extremely knowledgeable. Whenever new behavioral challenges came up, he was quick to answer our questions and provide practical solutions that truly worked.

One aspect we especially appreciated was that the training took place in different environments. Some sessions were held at home, where we could focus on everyday routines and behaviors, while others were outdoors, helping Fuji learn to stay focused and responsive despite the many distractions of the real world.

We are truly grateful to have had Kie as our trainer and would recommend him 100% to anyone looking for a knowledgeable, reliable, and dedicated dog trainer. Thank you, Kie, for everything you’ve done for Fuji!

Kie was awesome. He always brought immense knowledge and great energy to our sessions.
As first-time dog owners, we had a lot of questions. With Kie’s help, we are now equipped to properly train our bernedoodle to be a great addition to our household. Thanks again to Kie and to Canine Counselors!

Laury was simply amazing! I am so happy with the progress my dog has made since working with her. She has improved tremendously with walking and going on walks outside, her behavior at home, and especially with socialization around other people and dogs.

Laury gave us wonderful guidance, practical tips, and helped us understand how to better support our dog in different situations. The training was excellent, and we could see a huge difference in her confidence and behavior.

I’m truly grateful for everything Laury taught us and so happy with my dog’s development. I highly recommend Lauren to anyone looking for a caring, knowledgeable, and patient dog trainer!

I had a wonderful experience with Nora and the dog training program. The training was for me just as much as for Benji. Nora was extremely patient, respectful, flexible, and knowledgeable. She explained what to do and why it matter matters, so I could be consistent and confident. Meeting in public places helped me handle real-life situations with distractions. I also appreciated her helpful suggestions on healthy food choices. The lifetime group classes are a huge bonus. It’s great to keep reinforcing skills like heeling and sitting around other dogs and people. I feel more confident as an owner, and Benji is more confident too.’
Thank you Patti!

We had a great experience with Laura and Canine Counselors. Through her training and changes in his meds, my dog’s separation anxiety has finally become manageable. Going away more everyday!! So thankful they were able to help him and our family. Thank you!!
I loved the training for my puppy. First at and later group lessons . I am very grateful. My Training was very helpful with my concerns of potty training and socialization with my cats. 5 stars
Laura was amazing with my dogs, Lady and Teddy! She was always on time and friendly. And huge plus is that both dogs absolutely loved her!

We had a fantastic experience with Leslie. She helped our dog Ricky master sit, down, stay, come, leave it, drop it, heel, and several other useful commands.

Ricky listens better, is easier to manage, and has become an even more enjoyable part of our family life. Leslie’s training made a real difference.

Canine Counselors has trained all of my family’s dogs for many years, and we always have a great experience. Peter is wonderful, and most recently, Andres did an amazing job training our Portuguese Water Dog puppy, Kona. We are so grateful for their patience and guidance. Having a dog trainer when bringing a dog into your family is a non-negotiable, and Canine Counselors is the best!
Great experience with Canine counselors. Keith, Smokey's trainer was very knowledgeable! He took his time to explain the whys behind the different training!

Beto recently graduated from his obedience training, and we couldn't be happier with the progress he has made. The transformation has been incredible, and we will continue reinforcing everything he learned to help him keep improving.

A special thank you to Leslie, his trainer, for her outstanding work. She was knowledgeable, caring, and incredibly patient throughout the entire process. Her dedication and genuine love for the dogs made all the difference. We highly recommend her and the entire team to anyone looking for quality obedience training.
Thank you Jorge!

Our trainer Laury was a great trainer. We started with a puppy that did not listen and ended with a well behaved puppy, I highly recommend her for your puppy. It was a great experience. Elvis graduated today.

We had an amazing experience working with Kie! From day one, he was incredibly knowledgeable, patient, and encouraging throughout the entire training process with our puppy, Arturo.

Kie didn't just train Arturo, he taught us how to become better dog owners by explaining the reasoning behind each technique and giving us practical tips we could continue using at home. He was always willing to answer our questions, provide helpful feedback, and tailor his approach to Arturo's needs.

We've seen such a positive difference in Arturo's behavior and confidence. We're so grateful for his time, guidance, and support throughout the process. We highly recommend Kie to anyone looking for a knowledgeable trainer who truly cares about helping both dogs and their owners succeed!
Excellent service.  Laura is knowledgeable and patient!  She was able to promote connection and collaboration for our 8 year old and new puppy!  She gave us so many helpful tips!

We had an unbelievable experience with Nora as the trainer to our two pups! She was patient, and helped us through all of our problems. She was punctual, professional and was extremely knowledgeable on dog behavior and training techniques. Our dogs are now obsessed with her 😭. We can’t recommend her services highly enough! Thank you!

thank you so much Leslie for being such an incredible trainer. She is patient, knowledgeable, and truly cares about the dogs she works with. My dog made great progress, and I couldn’t be happier with the results. 💓 …

As a first time dog owner, I needed guidance and training for my puppy. Canine Counselors was a great investment. I signed up for their 8-week command training package. Our trainer, Nora, was wonderful. My puppy loved her weekly training and learned very fast from her. The training is not only for my puppy but also and very importantly for me as the owner! Nora is very experienced patient, and clear in her explanations - I gained a lot of knowledge and confidence in the process. I felt supported throughout the training, and with the ongoing group training classes on Saturdays, I feel supported with any behavior issues that may come up in the future.

Working with Leslie has been an amazing experience! She is incredibly knowledgeable, patient, and truly cares about every dog she works with. My puppy, Suki, absolutely loves her, and the results have been incredible. Suki learned all of her obedience commands, gained so much confidence, and proudly graduated from training!

I highly recommend Leslie to anyone looking for a caring, professional, and effective dog trainer. Thank you, Leslie, for giving Suki such a wonderful foundation—we’re so grateful!

Our dog Loui showed improvement in his behavior from the very first lesson he received from his trainer, Delvin Pineda, of Canine Counselors. Thank you, Delvin, for your professionalism and love for the pets you train.
Kie was great with us and our dog.  He helped us deal with socialization, barking, overly assertive excitement and more.  We have a better pet as a result.  We are grateful.
Laura was an amazing trainer! Very patient. My dog stopped pooping inside the house. So glad I hired this company. Thank you Laura.
Our puppy Wiggles had a great learning experience. His trainer, Leslie was great with him and gave us great tips to get our puppy trained quickly.
My family and my dogs LOVED our trainer Nora. Nora is very knowledgeable and friendly. Highly recommended!!!! We enjoyed and laughed in every class. My dog learned a lot. We will miss Nora!

💯 Recommend Canine Counselors! Our puppy Lola just finished her obedience training, and what a difference it has made. Nora, Lola’s trainer, was amazing. She’s very knowledgeable, explained everything step by step, and gave us lots of helpful tips along the way. She was patient when needed and firm when necessary, which really helped Lola learn. Lola absolutely loves her, and we’ve seen such great progress. We’re so happy with the whole experience 🐾❤️

Our experience with Canine Counselors was fantastic all thanks to our magnificent instructor, Delvin! Besides being knowledgeable, his professionalism and patience are unmatched and we highly recommend him for any and all dogs in need of a little extra attention. The only danger is now he’s made us want to get another dog! Thank you to Delvin and Canine Counselors! 🙏🏽
We are very happy with the results of the training of our dog thank you to our trainer Laura who is amazing, very knowledgeable and super sweet with dogs. Highly recommended!!

I can’t say enough good things about Canine Counselors and Kie. Nala had a great experience and we learned so much.

Kie helped my 4 year old dog Nala become more confident and comfortable while still keeping the same playful personality I love. She listens so much better now, knows her commands, and is such a happy dog. One of my favorite things is seeing how confident she can be now. I love seeing a smile on her face.

Kie was patient, knowledgeable, and clearly cared about Nala. It was clear from the start how much he loves what he does and is great at it.

I would recommend Canine Counselors (and Kie) to anyone looking for training that gets results while still letting your dog be themselves.

Deciding to go with canine counselors was one of the best decisions that we made. Andres our trainer was a wonderful. We have learned how to properly train our pug to not go to the bathroom in the house, sit, stay, down, heel, shake and play dead. I recommend this company to anyone! Thank you Andres!

THANK YOU DELVIN!!! You are the best! 👏 We have a very sneaky and very crazy 7 year old pitbull (Tesla) 😂 who was impossible to take on walks (mainly because we didn’t know how to handle her properly). Delvin gave us all the tools and taught us all the tricks to be able to have her sit, stay, down, come, place, off the couch, break, stop jumping on people when they came in the house, etc. We’re now taking her on daily walks and she’s doing so well. She walks by our side, she’s calm, and doesn’t get anxious when she sees other people/ducks/dogs. We’re very thankful and couldn’t have wished for a better trainer 🥹

I highly recommend Laura for Command Obedience Training. She was very patient, professional and extremely knowledgeable. In addition, Laura taught us to utilize the training techniques at home. Hazel's behavior has improved significantly as a result of the training.
Thank you,  Xander

I highly recommend this dog trainer! The patience, professionalism, and dedication shown during the training process were outstanding. My dog has improved so much in behavior and obedience, and I could see real progress after every session. The trainer truly cares about the dogs and takes the time to explain everything clearly to the owners as well. Thank you for all the hard work and support — it made a big difference for us!

Our trainer, Leslie, was amazing. Her positive methods and incredible patience completely transformed our dogs behavior. She gave us the tools and confidence to handle real world situations, making our daily walks and home life so much more peaceful. We highly recommend her to any owner who wants to train their dog.

We completed the training and we couldnt be happier! Kie was an excellent trainer and very caring with the dogs, he was always on time and with the best attitude! He gave us really good tips on our first travel with out puppy and guided us through the whole process or raising a puppy! We truly couldnt be more thankful for Kie!

Canine Counselors are lifesavers!

Andres was the best trainer I have had! Our puppy started off needing basic obedience and was dealing with resource guarding issues. Andre’s helped us manage this with 6 weeks worth of training and was available to answer all of our questions. While we continue to work with canine counselors on the monthly trainings, I hope to see Andre’s again soon! Thanks so much!!!

We have Toby, our 3 year old pit bull mix. From day 1 Laura was not afraid of him and was able to teach him and us how to do many things. She even ended up socializing Toby with other dogs and taking him out to public spaces. Toby loved working with Laura too!  We all have made a good friend as well.
This is our second time taking our dogs to Canine Counselors.  The training is for both you and the dog so be prepared to put some work in and continue the process between lessons. Repetition means Success- Thanks again Canine Counselors!
Laury was the best teacher super patient and kind. My puppy learned great with her!

A fantastic experience! My Schnoodle puppy was timid. After training, he's a completely different dog—disciplined, affectionate, and sociable. We are all incredibly grateful to our trainer, Devlin. His patience, dedication, and love for our pet were amazing. Thank you so much!
